question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A room for cleaning and storing dishes and cooking utensils and for doing messy kitchen work.
solution: The correct answer is: **Scullery**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Scullery"** refers to a small room adjoining a kitchen, used for cleaning and storing dishes, utensils, and performing messy kitchen tasks. (बरतन धोने का कमरा) • **Example:** The old house had a scullery where the servants cleaned the dishes and prepared ingredients for cooking. • **"Dormitory"** is a large room for sleeping, especially for students or workers. (छात्रावास/सोने का कमरा) • **Example:** The students retired to their dormitory after a long day of classes. • **"Sanatorium"** refers to a medical facility for people recovering from illness or for rest and recuperation. (आरोग्यशाला) • **Example:** He spent a few months in a sanatorium to recover from tuberculosis. • **"Overlay"** means a covering or layer placed over something else, typically for decoration or protection. (आच्छादन/परत) • **Example:** The table was covered with a beautiful lace overlay. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Scullery**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Dormitory** (छात्रावास/सोने का कमरा): A large sleeping room for multiple people, typically in schools or hostels. • **Example:** The dormitory was equipped with bunk beds for all the students. • **Sanatorium** (आरोग्यशाला): A medical facility for treating chronic diseases or for convalescence. • **Example:** After months of treatment, she was transferred to a sanatorium for recovery. • **Overlay** (आच्छादन/परत): A layer or covering placed on top of another. • **Example:** The artist added an overlay of gold leaf to enhance the painting. 36:Tc31, The correct answer is: **turbulent**.
